newsitem.title: USA: SeaChange gets purchase commitment from TCA.
newsitem.headline: SeaChange gets purchase commitment from TCA.

text.p: SeaChange International Inc said Wednesday TCA Cable TV 's CableTime made a multi-million dollar commitment to purchase the company's digital ad insertion systems and satellite services.
The company said the relationship will begin with 100 headend systems to be installed in 1998.

The company said CableTime manages ad sales in more than 500 headends in more than 30 states, reaching more than three million subscribers. CableTime expects to generate more than $60 million in gross revenue in its fiscal year ending October 31.

SeaChange International said its software-based system allows television operators to use distributed computing, video compression and data networking techniques to automate the distribution and management of ads, infomercials, local origination programming, movies and other revenue generating video.
